recentItems.title: "DO NOT STRIKE MOSCOW!": The CIA asks Ukraine for safe passage! US marine tells us the reason
recentItems.description:
On August 25, CIA Director John Ratcliffe made an unannounced visit to Moscow. However, the main geopolitical sensation was that, before the trip, Washington officially asked Kyiv to refrain from drone strikes on Moscow and St. Petersburg until the American delegation had left Russian territory!

A US Marine Corps veteran, reconnaissance sniper Matthew Sampson, who fought in the ranks of Ukraine’s Defense Forces and now lobbies for Ukraine’s interests in Congress, calls this request the event of the year: just three years ago, no one in Washington asked Kyiv’s permission to do business in Moscow — now they are forced to ask.
